name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - Bethlehem PA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled truck entrance at the SW corner of the building: a gatehouse/canopy structure sits squarely in the truck lane at the entry to the SW dock court, with channeled lanes (a separate down-arrow lane left of the booth, truck lane past it). A truck with a blue trailer is stopped at the booth in the 2026 Maxar imagery.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Built gatehouse structure (flat-roofed canopy booth, ~2-3 vehicle footprint) positioned in the truck driveway median at the gate; truck actively stopped at it confirms a staffed check-in point.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Gate appears to handle ~1 inbound lane past the booth; exact lane split inferred from pavement markings, low confidence.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Paved internal area south of the gatehouse where trucks can wait before the gate, but it is mixed with internal circulation/parking - medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~1,041,600 sq ft DC (built 2022) with dock doors along both long faces (NE and SW). Estimated 150 total doors from imagery; trailer/door rhythm visible but many doors empty - approximate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Multiple striped trailer stalls marked 'DROP POINT 7' / 'DROP POINT 10' across the dock courts; clearly well over 50 drop positions.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors on two physically separate building faces (NE long face and SW long face) - cross-dock layout with separate dock banks.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Large striped trailer stall capacity across both dock courts plus dock positions; estimate ~220, approximate.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property; truck-served only.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Bethlehem PA / Lehigh Valley distribution corridor adjacent to I-78 - dense major-metro industrial fabric (Majestic Bethlehem Center, 441-acre business park).
